name: Gristle O'Hog

greeting: Welcome to the Oily Eel! Best beds in the Mire, and I should know - I clean 'em myself!
Hog's the name, hospitality's the game! What can I get ya?
First time in the Mire? You look lost. Everyone looks lost their first time. You'll get used to it.
The Eel ain't fancy, but it's dry. Usually. When the roof ain't leaking.
Come in, come in! Leave your mud at the door, if you please.
Ah, fresh faces! The swamp's got a way of wearin' folks down. Rest yer bones here.
Gristle O'Hog, at your service! Don't let the name fool ya - I'm a sweetheart.
Room for the night? Food? Both? The Eel provides!
dialog.room_rental: Rooms are ten coin a night. Includes breakfast - assuming the chef ain't in one of his moods. Which he usually is.
dialog.bar_chat: Drinks are on tap, food's... edible. Mostly. The purple pigman in the kitchen - that's Percy - he experiments. Some experiments go better than others.
dialog.backstory: Came here from the Dustbelt. Got a cousin there, runs a trading post. Family resemblance is strong - we're all ugly as sin but twice as charming. The Mire called to me. Something about the damp. Reminds me of home.
rumors: That snakecharmer on the boardwalk? Claims he trained in the Uplands. Might be true - he's got that high-and-mighty air about him.
The dock bosses are fightin' again. White and Purple, at each other's throats. Bad for business, good for entertainment.
Heard tell there's a walking barrel out in the Deep Muck. My cousin in the Dustbelt - Barrelman Bob, you might know him - he says it's one of his. Escaped or something. Sounds like hogwash to me.
The foodboys near the docks? Don't eat the red one's sauce. I'm serious. I've seen grown men weep.

time_of_day.morning: Breakfast! Porridge, mostly. Sometimes with things in it. Don't ask what things.
time_of_day.noon: Lunch rush. If you can call three people a rush.
time_of_day.evening: Evening crowd's the best. Stories flow freer than the ale.
time_of_day.night: Closing time. Nothing good happens in the Mire after midnight.

mini_quest.stage_1_hook: Running low on supplies. The Deep Muck's got these root vegetables - glows faintly green, completely safe, probably - that'd really spice up the menu. Problem is, nobody wants to go mucking about in the Muck for vegetables.
mini_quest.stage_1_active: The glow-roots grow near the water's edge. Bring back a dozen and I'll make it worth your while.
mini_quest.stage_2_progress: Found those roots yet? Percy's threatening to make 'surprise stew' again. I need those ingredients.
mini_quest.stage_3_complete: Glow-roots! Perfect! Percy's already planning something ambitious. Here's your reward - and free meals at the Eel for a week. Don't say I never gave you nothin'.

party_reactions.nix7: Analysis: Innkeeper demonstrates 94% higher hygiene standards than zone average.
party_reactions.twist: He smells like bacon! ...Is that rude to say? I feel like that's rude.
party_reactions.korr: A fellow traveler who found his place. Admirable.
party_reactions.renna: The wards here are basic but functional. This one knows a little magic.
party_reactions.suresh: Your ale is acceptable. Your hospitality is better.
party_reactions.sova: Serves drinks. Serves food. Doesn't ask questions. I like him.
party_reactions.grit: Reminds me of every sergeant I ever had. Tough but fair.
party_reactions.ashka: The fireplace needs work. I could... help with that.
party_reactions.senna: Knows how to keep secrets. I can tell.
party_reactions.callum: Nice place! Cozy. In a... damp sort of way.

relationship_dialog.stranger: First drink's on the house. After that, we haggle.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Back again? Must be desperate or discerning. Either way, welcome.
relationship_dialog.friend: The usual? I've got it started already. Good to see you, friend.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Listen, if you ever need to lay low... there's a room in the back. No questions asked.

cross_npc_connections: barrelman_wood_dustbelt: My cousin Bob. Sells barrels. Bit obsessed, honestly. But family is family.
pigman_purple: Percy! My chef. Brilliant when he ain't being difficult. Secret recipe and all that.
snakecharmer_mire: Sssilas crashes here when it rains. Good for business - folks come to see the snake.
